name: Drizzle Team open-source org page by drizzle.team
description: A near-monochrome open-source org page where the data does the design work: eleven project cards each pair a star/fork count with a black sparkline charting traction over time. Structure is carried by tiny uppercase micro-labels and a two-line black/grey greeting, and the rhythm shifts down the page from a dense three-column card grid to a heavy light-grey sponsor panel and a sparse three-column footer. Colour is withheld almost entirely — white, greys, one dark button — leaving a single blue 'Become a sponsor' link as the only action accent.
